record_schema.visible_scope: free text describing only what the frame can actually assess
record_schema.flag_direction_class: free text qualitative direction or null

fairhope_municipal_pier_public: No north or south beach is visible; shoreline_directly_visible=false.
Primary predawn signals are unusual vehicle/person density, people with lights looking at water, and sustained search behavior.
Use water surface and flag motion/direction as qualitative environmental proxies.
Biological activity around the pier is useful when resolvable.
No unusual pier activity is never a Fairhope beach non-event.
grand_hotel_public: Use the west-southwest Bay view, Grand Hotel pier, Point Clear headland, central osprey pole and flag as fixed references.
Flag direction/strength remain qualitative until calibrated against independent wind observations.
A negative applies only to the actually visible WSW Bay/activity frame; unseen Point Clear/Zundel's/Mullet Point shoreline remains UNKNOWN.
Do not retain media without explicit rights.

guardrails: Use only permitted public viewing paths.
Do not bypass access controls or automated-access restrictions.
Do not save screenshots, thumbnails, video or image data unless separate source rights and owner permission explicitly permit it.
Do not identify shrimp from ambiguous specks.
Birds or people alone do not confirm a Jubilee.
Missing, stale, frozen, dark or poorly visible views must be overall=unknown.
Rebroadcasts of the same physical camera share one independence_group and count once.
Principal dawn assessment uses the first usable observation at/after civil dawn; if still too dark, biological evidence is UNKNOWN and daylight follow-up should use the dawn+20-minute observation.
No person identification or cross-camera identity tracking.
Do not invent historical checks or contact camera owners.
